messages.text:
Your order is paid and hasn't shipped yet. Nothing is wrong with it.

Your Magic M. 40T and the Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA are waiting on the production run of 300 units. That run is already on its way to our warehouses. You should get a tracking number by email by the end of November. Your miner will ship from our EU warehouse in the Netherlands to (address hidden).

You can follow that shipment to our warehouse at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
batches 3 to 6 seem to be in manufacturing status

The 40T isn't shipping in separate batches anymore. All 300 units were built as one production run, and that whole run is now on its way to our warehouses. Your order is part of it, so whatever batch it was sold under doesn't hold it back. Those batch cards on the page are behind.

Your tracking number should come by email by the end of November. Is there anything else on the order I can check for you?
